source: Comparative Agendas Project major topic codes: https://www.comparativeagendas.net/pages/master-codebook

topics.name: Macroeconomics
topics.description: Taxation, budgets, spending, deficits, inflation, economic growth, and management of the overall economy.

topics.name: Civil rights and liberties
topics.description: Civil rights, discrimination, voting rights, privacy, racial and gender equality, disability rights, and LGBTQ rights.

topics.name: Health
topics.description: Health care access and cost, insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, public health, mental health, and reproductive health.

topics.name: Agriculture
topics.description: Farming, ranching, agricultural markets, food safety, rural development, and agricultural land and water use.

topics.name: Labor and employment
topics.description: Wages, unions, collective bargaining, working conditions, unemployment, workplace safety, and employment law.

topics.name: Education
topics.description: Public schools, teachers, school funding, curriculum, higher education, tuition, student debt, school choice, and charter schools.

topics.name: Environment
topics.description: Pollution, clean air and water, conservation, wildlife, climate change, emissions, and environmental protection.

topics.name: Energy
topics.description: Electricity, utilities, fossil fuels, renewable and nuclear energy, energy prices, pipelines, and the power grid.

topics.name: Immigration
topics.description: Immigration and border enforcement, refugees, asylum, immigrant status, deportation, and sanctuary policies.

topics.name: Transportation
topics.description: Roads, bridges, public transit, rail, airports, ports, vehicles, traffic, and transportation funding.

topics.name: Law, crime and justice
topics.description: Policing, courts, sentencing, prisons, criminal justice reform, guns, drug enforcement, and public safety.

topics.name: Social welfare
topics.description: Poverty, food assistance, child care, family services, elderly and disability services, homelessness, and the safety net.

topics.name: Housing and community development
topics.description: Affordable housing, homeownership, rents, tenant protections, zoning, homelessness, and community development.

topics.name: Business, commerce and consumers
topics.description: Business regulation, small business, banking, finance, insurance markets, consumer protection, corporations, and competition.

topics.name: Defense and veterans
topics.description: Armed forces, National Guard, military installations, veterans benefits, troops, and homeland security.

topics.name: Science, technology and communications
topics.description: Broadband, telecommunications, internet policy, research, innovation, cybersecurity, data privacy, and artificial intelligence.

topics.name: Foreign trade
topics.description: Trade agreements, tariffs, exports, imports, and international commerce.

topics.name: International affairs
topics.description: Foreign policy, foreign aid, international organizations, treaties, war, diplomacy, and relations with other countries.

topics.name: Government operations
topics.description: Elections administration, redistricting, campaign finance, ethics, corruption, transparency, constitutions, and government structure.

topics.name: Public lands and water
topics.description: Public land management, parks, water rights, forests, mining, wilderness, tribal affairs, and natural-resource use.

topics.name: Culture, family and social issues
topics.description: Family, marriage, religion, arts, culture, sports, parental rights, and contested moral or social questions.
